mods.name: ClaudeCraft
mods.description:
Puts Claude Code inside your ComputerCraft computers.
Adds a built-in 'claude' API to all CC: Tweaked computers with streaming support. In API key mode the key stays on the server (an environment variable or a file outside the world and config folders) and is never sent to clients.

com/claudecraft/api/ChannelBackend.class: java/net/http/HttpClient.send in isConfigured, lambda$connectGlobalSSE$3, lambda$sendToolResult$2, lambda$sendMessage$1

releases.notes:
ClaudeCraft 1.3.0 for Minecraft 1.21.1 (**NeoForge**)

> **1.21.1 is now the only supported version.** The 1.16.5, 1.18.2, 1.19.2 and 1.20.1 Forge builds stopped at 1.2.1 and won't be updated, not even for security fixes. They still keep the API key in a server config that is sent to every player who joins. If you run one of them, move to 1.21.1.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.0+ (built against 21.1.234)
- [CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked) 1.117.1+
- An Anthropic API key, **or** Claude Code + [Bun](https://bun.sh) for Channel mode

### Install
Drop `claudecraft-1.3.0-mc1.21.1.jar` into `mods/` on a NeoForge 1.21.1 instance with CC: Tweaked, replacing any older ClaudeCraft jar.

### Upgrading from 1.2.x: read this first
- **The API key has moved out of the synced config.** On first start, ClaudeCraft moves `apiKey` from `claudecraft-server.toml` to the server-only file `<game dir>/claudecraft/api-key` and scrubs NeoForge's `.bak` copies. It logs a warning when it does. The env var `CLAUDECRAFT_API_KEY` also works. **Rotate your key**: older versions sent that config to every player who joined.
- **Channel mode is now off by default.** An operator must run `/claudecraft channel enable`, then `/claudecraft channel allow <computerId>` for each computer. The `allowAllInSingleplayer` config option covers private singleplayer worlds.
- **Computer-to-computer messages are allow-listed.** A computer only accepts messages from computers its player has allowed by typing `/allow <id>` in `claude`. Chains are limited in length and each sender is rate limited.
- **Anthropic server-side tools are blocked unless enabled.** Web search, web fetch and code execution need `allowServerTools = true`, and web access also needs `enableWebAccess`. The server enforces this for every Lua program, not just `claude`.

### New
- **Background jobs**: quarry, tree farm, crop farm and custom Lua jobs that keep running while you chat. Use `/jobs` to manage them. See [docs/background-jobs.md](https://github.com/west3436/claudecraft/blob/1.21.1/docs/background-jobs.md).
- **Memory and base atlas**:
  - per-computer notes (`remember` / `forget`, `/memory`);
  - a world-saved atlas of waypoints shared by all computers;
  - `atlas_search` ("where are my diamonds?") over past inventory scans.

  See [docs/memory-and-atlas.md](https://github.com/west3436/claudecraft/blob/1.21.1/docs/memory-and-atlas.md).
- **Item logistics tools** for moving and finding items across inventories, plus a bounded `get_recipes`.
- **`build_structure` shapes**: box, hollow box, wall, floor, cylinder, sphere/dome and gable roof. `dry_run` reports materials and fuel against the turtle's inventory, and builds can restock from a chest, preview on a monitor and return home safely.
- **Confirm mode and guardrails**: `/confirm` asks before risky tools run, and destructive tools have limits.
- **Prompt caching** in API key mode (`enablePromptCaching`, on by default), with cost per model in `/stats`.
- **One tool registry**: Channel mode now uses the same Lua tool definitions as API key mode.

### Security
- **Channel server:**
  - each session has its own auth token;
  - no CORS, and DNS-rebinding guards;
  - messages from other computers are treated as untrusted data.
- **Claude Code sessions** are locked down to the in-game tools, have a session limit, and are stopped reliably.
- **New operator commands**: `/claudecraft channel list | sessions | kill <id> | deny <id>`, plus `/claudecraft clearkey`.

### Fixes
- **History:** a trimmed or interrupted conversation no longer breaks every later request. History saves are atomic.
- **API key mode:**
  - tools whose input was cut off by `max_tokens` aren't run;
  - a stalled stream now fails after `requestTimeoutSeconds` instead of hanging;
  - a `null` stop reason no longer hangs the request.
- **Channel mode:**
  - the incoming-message listener reconnects automatically;

...

releases.notes:
ClaudeCraft 1.2.2 for Minecraft 1.21.1 — **NeoForge**

This release ports the 1.21.1 build from Forge to **NeoForge**. The previous 1.21.1 jars were built for Forge, but ClaudeCraft's required dependency — CC: Tweaked — ships as a **NeoForge** mod on 1.21.1, so the old Forge jars could never load. This build runs on NeoForge.

### Requirements
- Minecraft 1.21.1
- NeoForge 21.1.0+ (built and tested against 21.1.234)
- [CC: Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked) 1.117.1+

### Install
Drop `claudecraft-1.2.2-mc1.21.1.jar` into your `mods/` folder, alongside CC: Tweaked, on a **NeoForge** 1.21.1 instance.

### Changes
- Build migrated from ForgeGradle to ModDevGradle (NeoForge 21.1.x).
- `META-INF/mods.toml` → `META-INF/neoforge.mods.toml` (now depends on `neoforge`).
- Mod sources ported from `net.minecraftforge.*` to `net.neoforged.*` (FML constructor, `NeoForge.EVENT_BUS`, `@EventBusSubscriber`, `ModConfigSpec`, `BuiltInRegistries`).

Verified with a clean Gradle build and a NeoForge dedicated-server boot with the mod loaded against CC: Tweaked.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
